Name: (RETIRED) Void's weird Wonders - Furniture ( AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3][b][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod still works in 1.6. It will not be updated further though.[/i][/b][/size]

Back at it again with some spoopy stuff! Well, mostly.

There's mostly rugs and smaller things retextured(like futan bear) and in general it's just me having some fun making and editing sprites that fit my taste more. Thought that others might like it so I am uploading it here, maaybe even updating it with more once I can think of more stuff to add.

Overall it's cauldrons, some different colored magic circles from the wizard, rugs with a darker theme(some fitting to the wallpapers I've made before) and other smaller tibits like some potion bottles, runes, a crystal ball and more!

There's been an update with a few more things, first picture is the updated version(minus the magic circles because I am a silly man and forgot to add them to the screenshot...they are still in the pack!)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Alternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
